scope.target: Schema-valid pre-send validation for every delegated terminal completion callback
constraints: Keep source-task progress delivery terminal-only while allowing runtime-local commentary
Require the delegated task to validate its fully populated completion envelope against the dispatch before delivery
Treat missing or failed pre-send validation as non-passing and prohibit pass callbacks
Preserve callback or one event-wait delivery and one terminal-readback recovery without polling
non_goals: Repair a failed validation inside the delegated task
Create or push a release tag

steps: Extend the dispatch and completion contracts with pre-send schema validation evidence
Fail closed when the validation evidence or full completion shape is missing
Update templates, validator, routing guidance, and focused tests
Commit a clean immutable checkpoint and run one real source-task callback regression
execution.last_completed_step: Accepted one real schema 1.1 source-task callback after delegated pre-send validation and independent source-side cross-record validation

results.summary: Schema 1.1 requires the delegated task to validate the persisted dispatch/completion pair before delivery and bind the callback to the validated record. The real callback regression passed on fixed clean commit 14911780b0b78364ba454c9999e237ed9038f5a9.
tests_run: real source-task callback plus independent cross-record validator: passed
results.residual_risk: A runtime can still violate the contract, but any missing, failed, or drifting pre-send receipt now fails closed instead of being accepted as passing evidence.
